ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the graph, we can observe that when $y \leq 0$, then $x \geq 3$,\\
which means the solution set of the inequality $kx+b \leq 0$ is $\boxed{x \geq 3}$.
